# awx_config (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `analytics_collectors` (String) The analytics collectors registered on this installation, keyed by collector name.
- `analytics_status` (String) Whether analytics gathering is turned on.
- `become_methods` (String) The privilege escalation methods AWX accepts, as value and label pairs.
- `custom_virtualenvs` (List of String) Paths of the virtual environments left over from before execution environments. AWX treats these as deprecated.
- `eula` (String) The end user license agreement text. Empty on an open installation.
- `license_info` (String) Subscription details, including license type, expiry and the host counts it permits.
- `project_base_dir` (String) Filesystem path the installation stores project checkouts under.
- `project_local_paths` (List of String) Directories under the project base dir that a manual project can be pointed at.
- `time_zone` (String) The time zone the installation runs in, which schedules are evaluated against.
- `ui_next` (Boolean) Whether this installation serves the next generation user interface.
- `version` (String) The AWX version this installation runs, which is not necessarily the version the provider was generated against.
